correctness.rationale: The exact generic structural identity C=2+D+I+sum_H(1-z(H)) follows by classifying maximal bicliques on the event of no K2,3/K3,2 and disjoint squares. Probability of exceptions is O_c(1/n). Multivariate factorial moments yield independently Poisson cycle classes with marks 1-z. Covariance bounds yield Var(D),Var(I)=O_c(n) and the explicit first-order coefficient. Standalone finite Galois-derivation checker exhaustively confirmed every qualifying context with n<=4 and all five z-values. Finite checks only corroborate and do not certify the stochastic limit.
